headline: Dangote Group Companies Pay N104.74 Billion in Taxes Over Nine Months
summary: Companies linked to Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote remitted a combined N104.74 billion in taxes during the nine months ended September 30, 2026, according to corporate financial statements.
why: Dangote Group is Nigeria's largest industrial conglomerate, and its tax contributions are a key source of non-oil fiscal revenue for the Nigerian government.

impacts.name: Dangote Group
impacts.why: Financial filings showed group companies remitted N104.74 billion in tax payments across nine months.
